R1.description: On a null installation record, update --dry-run accepts the same input (--release-version or --release-dir) the real update accepts and previews it; a run that must choose the release is refused by both with the same cause and step

R2.description: The dry-run header names a null recorded version in words (a record with no workflow_version), never Python None; a recorded version prints byte for byte as before

R3.description: A deterministic test runs both commands on the same input and asserts the same decision, with a no-write proof for the accepted dry run and the refused run, and a failure-only mutation each; the one existing test pinning the old divergence is edited

R4.description: Every other message, every other exit code, doctor, a record damaged but not null, and every Workflow file stay byte-identical; the two user pages state the exact current rule

R5.description: Roadmap row 28 and the active-milestone record are kept in step; fix patch release
